description: This Java class implements the <entity-and> element used within the OFBiz minilang framework, providing functionality to perform entity find operations with specific criteria. It manages parameters, validation, execution of the find, and artifact information gathering.

classes.name: EntityAnd
classes.description: A class representing the <entity-and> element, facilitating entity retrieval with specific criteria in the mini-language of OFBiz.

classes.name: EntityAnd.EntityAndFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of EntityAnd from XML elements.

methods.name: EntityAnd
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EntityAnd object, validating attributes and creating the ByAndFinder object.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the entity find operation using the retrieved delegator and the finder object.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Gathers and adds artifact information related to the entity name involved.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EntityAnd object, primarily for debugging.
